name: claude-work-toolkit
description: Small, independent Claude plugins: plain writing, Excel financial models and a Gmail contacts list. Install only what you need.

plugins.name: plain-writing
plugins.description: Rewrite text so it reads like a person wrote it, and simplify it to plain, short sentences in any language.

plugins.name: gmail-contacts-crm
plugins.description: Build and refresh a personal contacts spreadsheet from your own Gmail and Google Calendar. Read only, never sends email.

plugins.name: financial-model-builder
plugins.description: Build clean Excel financial models (loans, breakeven, cost and scenario models) with zero formula errors.
